findings.highlight: I wake up up at the same time as usual
findings.evidenceJa: いつも通りの時間に目を覚ます
findings.governingReading: Shirou wakes at his usual time.
findings.explanation: The English duplicates “up,” producing an elementary grammatical error.

findings.evidenceJa: 夜明けを迎えたばかりの空は薄暗く
findings.governingReading: The sky is still dim just after dawn.
findings.explanation: The English changes the completed arrival of dawn into an ongoing dawn and omits the dimness.

findings.highlight: Already… Knew what that shadow is?
findings.evidenceJa: とっくの昔に、あの影の正体を知っていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou suspects Rin knew the shadow’s identity long ago.
findings.explanation: The English preserves prior knowledge but drops how far back he imagines it extending.

findings.highlight: I’ll go get you in the afternoon
findings.evidenceJa: 夕方になったら呼びにいく
findings.governingReading: Rin promises to wake or fetch Shirou in the evening.
findings.explanation: The English moves the planned wake-up earlier into the afternoon.

findings.highlight: she might test it on me if I do object
findings.evidenceJa: それじゃ試してみる？　なんて言われそう
findings.governingReading: Shirou stays quiet because Rin might answer his objection by asking whether he wants to try it.
findings.explanation: The English changes a feared teasing offer into Rin testing him without consent.

findings.highlight: the most I can do for Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜にとって一番大きな贈り物
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes renewed sisterhood would be the greatest gift for Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes the value of the gift to a limit on Shirou’s capacity.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は今夜のうちに臓硯に挑む
findings.governingReading: Rin said that she would challenge Zouken tonight.
findings.explanation: The English changes Rin’s planned agency into a joint action.

findings.highlight: If I’m to eliminate it, I have to
findings.evidenceJa: もしアレを消せるとしたら
findings.governingReading: Shirou conditionally reasons that if the shadow can be erased at all, perhaps only its projector or supplying source can be erased.
findings.explanation: The English turns a speculative boundary on possibility into actions he personally has to take.

findings.governingReading: The written term is magical energy while its ruby reads electricity, sustaining the projector analogy.
findings.explanation: The English retains only magical energy and loses the electrical reading.
